content.test_md_blob:
# Clear a locked performance point with Escape

> Prove the Escape key clears a locked chart-point selection after the point has been locked.

## Step 1

Open {{portfolio_overview_url}} in a browser and wait for the Portfolio Overview workspace to finish loading with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On the Portfolio Performance chart, hover and click a visible data point so the chart enters a locked selection state with its tooltip and lock icon visible.

## Step 3

capture baseline: locked chart-point selection before Escape.

## Step 4

Press Escape while the locked point is still active.

## Step 5

Confirm the chart returns to an unlocked state with the prior lock cleared.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-31

Confirm state-transition check: no locked chart-point selection (equals) — the stated promise: Pressing Escape clears a locked chart-point selection.
